How is the clause met?
options: Keep the main-only rule and correct the repro and goal clause to expect keep one and keep two only
Change text() to add the content after </main> to the text of a page with a main
gates.recommendation: Keep the main-only rule and correct the repro and goal clause to expect keep one and keep two only
